Why it is here: a short, coordinated entrance timeline for the welcome and workspace panels and a
quick transition when the workspace changes (js/components/motion.js). It is loaded lazily, only
when the user has not asked for reduced motion, and the interface works fully without it.

Integrity: tests/test_frontend_motion.py pins the SHA-256 above. To update, replace the file with a
new official build, update this notice and the pinned hash together.
